text: Esaera zaharrak dioenez: «Zenbat buru, hainbat…». Nola amaitzen da?
gloss: The old saying goes: 'So many heads, so many…' How does it end? — aburu: «Zenbat buru, hainbat aburu». 'Iritzi' means the same but is not the saying (and breaks the rhyme).

text: Gaur astelehena da. Zer egun izango da etzi?
gloss: Today is Monday. What day will it be 'etzi'? — Wednesday: Basque has its own word, etzi, for the day after tomorrow.

text: «Zazpiak bat» leloak dio Euskal Herriak zazpi lurralde dituela. Horietatik lau Hegoaldean daude. Zenbat daude Iparraldean?
gloss: The motto 'Seven are one' says the Basque Country has seven territories; four are in the South. How many in the North? — Three: Lapurdi, Lower Navarre, Zuberoa.

text: Bilboko Guggenheim museoaren aurrean, loreez estalitako eskultura erraldoi bat dago. Zer animalia da?
gloss: In front of the Bilbao Guggenheim stands a giant sculpture covered in flowers. What animal is it? — A dog (Jeff Koons's 'Puppy'). The spider is a trap: Louise Bourgeois's 'Maman' is on the other side of the museum, but not made of flowers.

text: Tradizioaren arabera, zer lanbide du Olentzerok, Gabon-gauean menditik jaisten den pertsonaiak?
gloss: By tradition, what is the trade of Olentzero, who comes down from the mountain on Christmas Eve? — A charcoal burner.

text: Intsektuek sei hanka dituzte, baina armiarma ez da intsektua. Zenbat hanka ditu armiarmak?
gloss: Insects have six legs, but a spider is not an insect. How many legs does a spider have? — Eight.

text: Landareek eguzki-argiarekin elikagaia sortzen dutenean, zein gas hartzen dute airetik?
gloss: When plants make food from sunlight, which gas do they take from the air? — Carbon dioxide (photosynthesis); oxygen is what they release.

text: Trena 10:40an irten da eta 12:15ean iritsi. Zenbat iraun du bidaiak?
gloss: The train left at 10:40 and arrived at 12:15. How long was the trip? — 1 h 35 min (20 min to 11:00, 1 h 15 min more). '75 minutes' is the autopilot subtraction 1215 − 1040.

text: Zein itsasok bustitzen ditu Bartzelonako hondartzak?
gloss: Which sea washes Barcelona's beaches? — The Mediterranean (the Bay of Biscay/Cantabrian Sea is the Basque one).

text: Udako Olinpiar Jokoak lau urtean behin egiten dira, eta Parisekoak 2024an izan ziren. Zein urtetan izango dira hurrengoak, Los Angelesen?
gloss: Summer Olympics are every four years; Paris was 2024. When are the next ones, in Los Angeles? — 2028. 2026 is the Winter Games year; 2032 is Brisbane.

text: Marmitakoa arrantzaleen platera da: patata, piperra eta zein arrain?
gloss: Marmitako is a fishermen's dish: potato, pepper and which fish? — Albacore/bonito (hegaluzea).

text: Anbotoko Dama ere esaten zaio, eta mendietako kobetan bizi omen da. Nor da euskal mitologiako jainkosa nagusi hau?
gloss: Also called the Lady of Anboto, said to live in mountain caves. Who is this chief goddess of Basque mythology? — Mari. Lamia, Basandere and the witch are lesser female figures of the same lore.

text: Zer lanbide du Nintendoren Mario pertsonaiak, bere anaia Luigik bezala?
gloss: What is the trade of Nintendo's Mario, like his brother Luigi? — Plumber. (Carpenter, his very first job in 1981, is left out on purpose.)

text: «Liburutegi» liburuen lekua da, eta «ardandegi» ardoarena. Zer saltzen da, beraz, «harategi» batean?
gloss: A 'liburutegi' is the place of books, an 'ardandegi' of wine. So what is sold in a 'harategi'? — Meat (haragi + -tegi). Stones and thread are traps on the sound 'har-'.

text: Nork idatzi zuen «Obabakoak», euskal literaturako liburu itzulienetako bat?
gloss: Who wrote 'Obabakoak', one of the most translated books of Basque literature? — Bernardo Atxaga (1988).

text: Zergatik flotatzen da errazago itsasoan ibaian baino?
gloss: Why is it easier to float in the sea than in a river? — Salt water is denser, so it pushes up harder (buoyancy).

text: Panamako kanalak bi ozeano lotzen ditu. Zein?
gloss: The Panama Canal links two oceans. Which? — The Atlantic and the Pacific (Suez is the one that points towards the Indian Ocean).

text: Zer ontzi mota erabiltzen da Donostiako Kontxako Bandera estropadan?
gloss: What kind of boat is raced in San Sebastián's Kontxa Flag regatta? — The trainera (trainerua). The batel is a smaller Basque rowing boat used in other races.

text: Kontrabaxua eta biolina familia berekoak dira, baina kontrabaxua askoz handiagoa da, hari luzeago eta lodiagoekin. Nolakoa da, beraz, haren soinua?
gloss: Double bass and violin are one family, but the bass is far bigger, with longer, thicker strings. So its sound is…? — Lower: longer, heavier strings vibrate more slowly.

text: Mendi-bide batek 12 km ditu. Igotzean orduko 3 km egiten dituzu, eta bide beretik jaistean orduko 6 km. Zenbat denbora behar duzu joan-etorrirako?
gloss: A mountain path is 12 km. You climb at 3 km/h and come down the same way at 6 km/h. How long is the round trip? — 6 hours: 4 up + 2 down. Averaging the speeds (4.5 km/h) is the trap.

text: Astelehena «astearen lehena» da, astearte «tartekoa» eta asteazkena «azkena». Izenen logikari jarraituz, zenbat egun zituen aste hark?
gloss: Monday is 'the first of the week', Tuesday 'the one between', Wednesday 'the last'. Following the names' logic, how many days did that week have? — Three: first, middle, last. (Read in the names; the question claims no more than that.)

text: Itsas mailan ura 100 °C-tan irakiten da. Zer gertatzen da Everesten gailurrean?
gloss: At sea level water boils at 100 °C. What happens on top of Everest? — It boils below 100 °C (about 70 °C): lower air pressure means a lower boiling point.

text: Andeetako mendi gainean eraikitako Machu Picchu hiria zein zibilizaziorena zen?
gloss: Machu Picchu, built high in the Andes, belonged to which civilisation? — The Inca. The others are Mesoamerican.

text: Bilbon eguerdiko 12:00ak direnean, zer ordu da Londresen?
gloss: When it is noon in Bilbao, what time is it in London? — 11:00: Spain is on Central European Time, the UK one hour behind, and both change clocks on the same dates.

text: Idiazabal gazta zein ardi-arraza autoktonoren esnearekin egiten da batez ere?
gloss: Idiazabal cheese is made mainly from the milk of which native sheep breed? — Latxa. The others are Spanish breeds (Manchega makes Manchego).

text: «Handia» filmak (2017) XIX. mendeko gizon erraldoi baten istorioa kontatzen du. Zein gipuzkoar herritakoa zen?
gloss: The film 'Handia' (2017) tells the story of a 19th-century giant. Which Gipuzkoan village was he from? — Altzo: Miguel Joaquín Eleizegi, 'the giant of Altzo'.

text: Byte batek zortzi bit ditu, eta bit bakoitzak 0 edo 1 balio du. Zenbat konbinazio desberdin har ditzake byte batek?
gloss: A byte has eight bits, each 0 or 1. How many different combinations can a byte take? — 256 (2^8). 255 is the trap: the largest value, but 0 counts too.

text: Mikel Laboak abestu zuen «Txoria txori», baina nork idatzi zuen poema?
gloss: Mikel Laboa sang 'Txoria txori', but who wrote the poem? — Joxean Artze. The others are poets of the same generation.

text: Sushiaren arroza zerekin ontzen da, egosi ondoren?
gloss: What is sushi rice seasoned with after cooking? — Rice vinegar (with sugar and salt). Soy sauce is for dipping.

text: Txapelketa batean zortzi taldek jokatzen dute, eta talde bakoitzak gainerako guztien aurka behin jokatzen du. Zenbat partida jokatuko dira guztira?
gloss: Eight teams each play every other team once. How many matches in total? — 28 (8 × 7 ÷ 2). 56 counts every match twice.

text: Euskarazko lehen liburu inprimatua «Linguae Vasconum Primitiae» izan zen, 1545ean. Nork idatzi zuen?
gloss: The first printed book in Basque was 'Linguae Vasconum Primitiae' (1545). Who wrote it? — Bernat Etxepare. Leizarraga is the trap: his New Testament came in 1571.

text: Jorge Oteizak Arantzazuko basilikaren fatxadarako apostoluak landu zituen. Zenbat dira?
gloss: Jorge Oteiza carved the apostles for the facade of the Arantzazu basilica. How many are there? — Fourteen, not the expected twelve.

text: Eguzkiaren argiak zortzi minutu inguru behar ditu Lurrera iristeko. Zenbat behar du argiak Ilargitik Lurrera iristeko?
gloss: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to reach Earth. How long does light take from the Moon? — About one second: ~384,000 km at ~300,000 km/s.

text: Nork aurkitu zuen Tutankamonen hilobia 1922an, ia osorik?
gloss: Who found Tutankhamun's nearly intact tomb in 1922? — Howard Carter. Schliemann (Troy), Evans (Knossos) and Petrie (Egypt) are fellow archaeologists.

text: Zein urte da MCMXCII erromatar zenbakitan?
gloss: Which year is MCMXCII in Roman numerals? — 1992: M 1000 + CM 900 + XC 90 + II 2.

text: Jaioberri batek 300 hezur inguru ditu, eta heldu batek 206. Zer gertatzen da bitartean?
gloss: A newborn has about 300 bones, an adult 206. What happens in between? — Some bones fuse together (skull, sacrum, etc.).

text: Euskaltzaindiak euskara batuaren oinarriak Arantzazun finkatu zituen. Zein urtetan?
gloss: The Basque Academy laid the foundations of standard Basque at Arantzazu. In which year? — 1968. 1919 is the trap: the year the Academy was founded.

text: Donostian sortutako Gilda pintxoak 1946ko film baten izena darama. Zein aktorek jokatu zuen Gildaren papera?
gloss: The Gilda pintxo, born in San Sebastián, is named after a 1946 film. Which actress played Gilda? — Rita Hayworth.

text: «Robot» hitza antzerki-lan batean agertu zen lehen aldiz. Zein hizkuntzatatik dator?
gloss: The word 'robot' first appeared in a play. Which language does it come from? — Czech: Karel Čapek's 'R.U.R.', from 'robota', forced labour.

text: Titikaka lakua bi herrialderen artean banatuta dago: Bolivia eta zein?
gloss: Lake Titicaca is shared by two countries: Bolivia and which? — Peru.

text: Fausto eta Juan José Elhuyar anaiek 1783an isolatu zuten lehen aldiz, Bergaran. Zein elementu?
gloss: Which element did the Elhuyar brothers first isolate in 1783 at Bergara? — Tungsten (wolfram). Platinum is a trap: it was also studied at Bergara, by Chabaneau.

text: Elkanoren itsasontzia 1522an itzuli zen, Lurrari lehen bira eman ondoren. Egunak arretaz zenbatu arren, egun bat falta zitzaien egutegian. Zergatik?
options: Ekuatorea gurutzatzean egun bat galtzen delako
gloss: Elcano's ship returned in 1522 after the first trip round the world; though they had counted carefully, their calendar was a day behind. Why? — Sailing west, following the Sun, each day was slightly longer; one full circuit loses a whole day (what the date line fixes today). Pigafetta recorded it at Cape Verde.

text: Ama euskalduna zuen eta Ziburun jaio zen, 1875ean. Zein konpositore?
gloss: He had a Basque mother and was born in Ciboure in 1875. Which composer? — Maurice Ravel. The others are French contemporaries.

text: Hauetatik zein euskal hitzetan dago gaztelaniako hitz arrunt baten jatorria, eta ez alderantziz?
gloss: Which of these Basque words is the source of a common Spanish word, rather than the other way round? — Ezker, the source of Spanish 'izquierda' (pre-Roman; the DLE cites Basque ezker). Bake (pacem), gorputz (corpus) and eliza (ecclesia) came from Latin into Basque.

text: Hauetatik zein herrialdek ez du Kaspiar itsasoarekin mugarik?
gloss: Which of these countries does not border the Caspian Sea? — Armenia (landlocked; the Caspian states are Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran, Azerbaijan).

text: Zein museotan dago Hieronymus Boschen «Lurreko Atseginen Lorategia» triptikoa?
gloss: In which museum is Hieronymus Bosch's triptych 'The Garden of Earthly Delights'? — The Prado, Madrid. The Rijksmuseum is the Dutch trap (Bosch was Dutch).

text: Joseph Conradek poloniera zuen ama-hizkuntza. Zein hizkuntzatan idatzi zituen bere eleberriak, «Iluntasunaren bihotza» barne?
gloss: Joseph Conrad's mother tongue was Polish. In which language did he write his novels, 'Heart of Darkness' included? — English (French was his second language).

text: Zein zientzialarik deszifratu zuen erleen «dantza», hau da, nola adierazten dioten elkarri lore baten norabidea eta distantzia?
gloss: Which scientist decoded the bees' 'dance', how they tell each other a flower's direction and distance? — Karl von Frisch. Lorenz and Tinbergen shared his 1973 Nobel Prize, for other work.

text: Tim Berners-Leek World Wide Weba asmatu zuen 1989an. Non lan egiten zuen orduan?
gloss: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989. Where did he work then? — CERN, near Geneva. MIT is the trap: he moved there later.

text: Zein mahats-motarekin egiten da batez ere Getariako txakolina?
gloss: Which grape variety is Getaria txakoli mainly made from? — Hondarrabi Zuri.
